description: a friendly tame red fox, a loyal animal companion, with a white chest, black legs and a bushy white-tipped tail, seen from the side in profile facing right, trotting mid-stride with one front paw raised, the whole fox from the ears to the tip of the tail inside the image, isolated animal on a plain background, forest fantasy
